description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Dark Ability Boost, Triplecast Dark, Unlimited Dark Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Dark Abilities, Dark Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Dark Abilities; Ends after using 8 Dark abilities
TP Max: AOE Dark/NE summon magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: War-Awoken Phantom Assault (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Dark/NE piercing summon magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Dark Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has at least 0/40% Dark Damage
WS Blue: Dark Damage +30% to all allies
WS Gold: Sorcery Damage +20% to all allies
